name: doggybank
description: A poker arena for independently hosted strategy bots.

scripts.setup: uv sync --all-packages --group check && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.demo: uv run --package doggybank-server python -m doggybank_server.play --game 'doggybank(num_players=2,blinds=1 2,stack_sizes=200 200)' --bot doggybank_server.poker_bot:make_call_bot --seat-bot 1=doggybank_server.poker_bot:make_raise_bot --spectate --server-per-seat --port 8787
scripts.bot:call: uv run --package doggybank-server python -m doggybank_server.remote_bot_server --port 9001 --bot doggybank_server.poker_bot:make_call_bot
scripts.bot:raise: uv run --package doggybank-server python -m doggybank_server.remote_bot_server --port 9002 --bot doggybank_server.poker_bot:make_raise_bot
scripts.test:server: uv run --all-packages --group test python -m unittest discover -s apps/server/tests -p '*_test.py'
scripts.test: pnpm test:server && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:docs
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @doggybank/web exec react-router typegen && vp check && pnpm --filter @doggybank/web check && pnpm check:server && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:workflows
scripts.check:server: uv run --all-packages --group check --group test ruff format --check && uv run --all-packages --group check --group test ruff check && uv run --all-packages --group check --group test ty check
